bullets: Delivered 15+ full-scope security assessments across web applications, REST APIs, and mobile clients supporting connected-device platforms at scale.

Discovered critical JWT authentication bypass in inter-service API gateway; demonstrated reachable impact to device provisioning and fleet telemetry, resulting in 48-hour fix cycle and rotation of shared signing secrets.
Identified access-control flaws (IDOR, mass assignment) across customer-facing telematics APIs; authored fix guidance later adopted as internal secure-coding checklist.
Ran grey-box engagements against mobile clients using Frida + Objection to bypass certificate pinning and validate backend authorisation independent of the mobile SDK.
Produced dual-audience reports: executive summaries for leadership + technical detail with reproduction steps for engineering, supporting sprint-level remediation planning.
Performed continuous web application + API pentests for enterprise SaaS customers across financial services and technology sectors.
Investigated production WAF telemetry to distinguish real attacks from noise; contributed rule tuning that reduced false-positive alert volume for customer SOC teams.
Authored vulnerability writeups mapped to CWE / OWASP references with clear reproduction steps, business-impact framing, and prescriptive remediation guidance.
Collaborated with customer engineering teams on fix validation cycles; regularly retested to confirm remediation before final report sign-off.
Supported cybercrime investigations including preliminary digital forensics on seized devices, OSINT-driven suspect identification, and evidence chain-of-custody documentation.
Assisted victim intake and case triage across financial fraud, social-engineering, and unauthorised-access incidents.
Contributed to internal case-tracking + reporting workflow improvements adopted across the analyst team.
